description: Paraguay's National Institute of Statistics published the final results of the 2022 National Census of Population and Dwellings with a workbook of 98 sheets on dwellings and households. For Asunción and for every district of each department it gives occupied private dwellings by type, the number with running water, sanitary drainage, waste collection and electricity with the average persons per dwelling, household headship by sex, access to information and communication technologies and ownership of household goods. National sheets compare dwelling types from 1992 to 2022 and basic services from 2002 to 2022, and three sheets cover collective dwellings. In Central department, 505,449 occupied private dwellings were counted, 503,916 of them with electricity and 371,495 with waste collection. A PDF report on dwellings and a presentation accompany the tables. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF downloads from the census results page. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Licencia de Uso de la Información Pública del Gobierno Paraguayo. Caveats: one sheet per department and topic, with footnotes defining each service, and counts, not shares. Simulation uses: district service coverage gaps for water, sanitation, waste and power planning, and dwelling counts for exposure. Related records: the SIAGUA Paraguay water information system and the CONATEL Paraguay coverage maps.
